pieces.file: Dub Lineage — rich — the engineer plays.m4a
pieces.title: The engineer plays
pieces.caption: Press play; the picture beneath says what you are hearing. *What is real and what is a choice:* Synthesized here from nothing; the picture is drawn from the mix's own parts. The echo is a plain tap echo, which the Retrospective Delay page says its own delay is not. *Leaking in:* Retrospective Delay: the echo as memory of what was pulled.

pieces.file: Dub Lineage — rich — the engineer plays — picture.svg
pieces.title: The engineer plays · drawn
pieces.caption: Two bars of a full riddim. Then parts are pulled: drum and bass alone, then bass alone while an echo goes on repeating a rim shot that is no longer there. In bar seven the bass and kick drop out too, leaving hat and skank. Everything returns in the last bar.
